environment.description: Kubernetes 1.28 cluster with namespace-level Pod Security Standards label set to 'restricted' profile at enforce level (pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted). Additionally, a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'disallow-host-path-and-privilege' with validationFailureAction: Enforce contains two rules: (1) rule 'restrict-hostpath' validates that spec.volumes[*] does not contain hostPath entries, (2) rule 'restrict-privilege-escalation' validates spec.containers[*].securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation == false AND spec.containers[*].securityContext.privileged is undefined or false. The container image is built with a distroless base (gcr.io/distroless/static) and the process runs as UID 65534 (nobody). An emptyDir volume is mounted at /app/data with sizeLimit 100Mi. No hostPath volumes are permitted by either the PSS label or the Kyverno policy.
